recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17334 unless a future work-group decision changes the Claim/Account/Encounter billing-diagnosis model or the preferred terminology binding.
issue_request: FHIR-17334 was a Published FHIR-core Claim change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for STU3, asking to add Claim.diagnosis.onAdmission as a 0..1 CodeableConcept for Present on Admission so claim diagnosis entries can distinguish conditions present at admission from those acquired during the encounter.
initial_application: Historical commit 956d07693a40d0adaa97b924fd31e6ba7737f2f2 (Tracker #17334) applied the request to the Claim spreadsheet, and the later source restructure commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried the element and value set into current XML source.
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml is in current build scope. Later core issues FHIR-22797, FHIR-24014, FHIR-28187, and FHIR-28188 discuss Claim/Encounter/Account diagnosis modeling and were resolved no-change or not-persuasive, preserving the distinction between billing-oriented Claim/Account content and Encounter content. A 2025 Zulip POA discussion and later triaged PA issues FHIR-50824/FHIR-50827 identify possible future Encounter/diagnosis terminology work but do not make a final change to Claim.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current Claim StructureDefinition already defines Claim.diagnosis.onAdmission with short text Present on admission, 0..1 cardinality, CodeableConcept type, and a binding to the example diagnosis-on-admission value set.
